# go-music-dl AI API

Use the running service's compact JSON API instead of scraping rendered HTML.

Start:

- `GET {base}/api/ai/index`
- `GET {base}/api/ai/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq,netease&limit=5`

Discover:

- Rankings/toplists: `GET {base}/api/ai/toplists`
- Playlist categories: `GET {base}/api/ai/playlist-categories`
- Playlists in a category: `GET {base}/api/ai/category-playlists`
- Recommendations: `GET {base}/api/ai/recommend`
- Account playlists: `GET {base}/api/ai/user-playlists`

Details:

- Playlist or local collection: `GET {base}/api/ai/playlist`
- Album: `GET {base}/api/ai/album`
- Ranked chart songs: `GET {base}/api/ai/toplist`

Play and download:

- Stream: `GET {base}/download?...&stream=1`
- Playback check: `GET {base}/inspect`
- Lyrics: `GET {base}/lyric`
- Queue status: `GET {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue songs: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue a complete container: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue/container`

Library and health:

- Compact local music: `GET {base}/api/ai/local-music`
- Local collections: `GET {base}/collections`
- Collection songs: `GET {base}/collections/{id}/songs`
- Health: `GET {base}/healthz`

`{base}` defaults to `/music`. The runtime index is the source of truth for parameters. Use small limits and only the sources you need. Preserve a song's `extra` object because some platforms require it for playback or lyrics. Write calls must send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`. Do not expose cookies, login, or configuration endpoints to an AI client.
